description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PartsQuery" name="Parts query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PartsBatch" name="Parts batch"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Project" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Query" name="Query parts" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderOne" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_OrderCheapestOneShop" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSeveral" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_OrderCheapestSeveralShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PartsArrive" name="Parts arrive" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstPartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder (cheapest)" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder (fastest)" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderArrive" name="Reordered parts arrive" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_ReorderedPartsArrive"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Need" name="Parts needed for contract project">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops for quantity, price and delivery time" messageRef="Msg_PartsQuery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OffersReceived" name="Offers received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Offers" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Determine which shops have the parts, prices and delivery times">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateOrderList" name="Create list of parts to order from each shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Coverage" name="One shop has enough parts?" default="Flow_07">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderCheapestOneShop" name="Order cheapest parts from one shop" messageRef="Msg_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderCheapestSeveralShops" name="Order cheapest parts from several shops" messageRef="Msg_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstPartsArrive" name="First parts arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstParts" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Ready to build">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build with parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock level of each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockLevel" name="Stock level of a part?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts" messageRef="Msg_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts again" messageRef="Msg_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteComplaintMail" name="Write mail to friends complaining about web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReorderMerge" name="Reorder placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReorderedPartsArrive" name="Reordered parts arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Reordered" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintSent" name="Complaint mail written">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Need" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Event_OffersReceived" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_CreateOrderList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CreateOrderList" targetRef="Gateway_Coverage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="One shop has enough parts" sourceRef="Gateway_Coverage" targetRef="Task_OrderCheapestOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${singleShopCoversAllParts == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Not enough parts in one shop" sourceRef="Gateway_Coverage" targetRef="Task_OrderCheapestSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_OrderCheapestOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_OrderCheapestSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Event_FirstPartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_FirstPartsArrive" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockLevel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Stock at least 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock >= 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Stock 3 or 4: reorder cheapest" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock >= 3 && stock < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Stock 1 or 2: reorder fastest again" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock > 0 && stock < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge" targetRef="Event_ReorderedPartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Event_ReorderedPartsArrive" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail" targetRef="End_ComplaintSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
